tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions are as per the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder is eligible only if a Permission letter (not older than last two years) is provided from Paper mill confirming that the material will be pulped at their mill. In case the Permission letter is not obtained from paper mill, then the bidder should produce a proof for having pulped paper in a paper mill.
Income Tax Assessed for the past three assessment years viz 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 Copies of Assessment Order / copy of Returns filed

Certificate confirming proprietary firm (from Bank or Chartered Accountant) / partnership firm (Partnership Deed copy) / private limited company / public limited company (Memorandum & Articles of Association)
Bidder Details in Annexure-1 of this Document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate for the last three years not less than Rs. 30 lakh
Soft Copy of GST and PAN should be enclosed
